subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

A pack of wolves / were chasing / the deer / in the forest.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **were chasing**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace '**were**' with '**was**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• The error here lies in the **subject-verb agreement**, i.e the grammatical rule that the verb or verbs in
